notes: Ribosome-profiling series (Li 2012 / Oh 2011 protocol): the shared extract protocol says 'mRNA fragments were size selected via gel purification', so all candidate mRNA-seq and Total RNA-seq samples get assay_class other per the settled rule (the protocol text is shared and does not separate the Total RNA arm). Growth phase left out: 37C samples at OD420 0.4 (not OD600, no phase word), cold-shock samples from OD420 1.1 with no phase given. Rifampicin samples (post-rif): treatment abx_transcription;cold, exposure left out because the two treatments have different durations (rif 2 h, cold 4 h). culture_mode/oxygen only for 10C samples (10C shaker).

base_medium.q: MOPS rich defined medium minus methionine, Teknova

medium_class.q: MOPS medium supplemented with 0.2% glucose, 19 amino acids (without methionine), vitamins, bases and micronutrients

assay_class.q: mRNA fragments were size selected via gel purification, and ligated to 5' adenylated DNA oligo

inducer_added.q: Ribosome profiling, total RNA/mRNA-seq and DMS-seq data at 37°C and following cold shock in E. coli

transcription_arrested.q: Ribosome profiling, total RNA/mRNA-seq and DMS-seq data at 37°C and following cold shock in E. coli

mixed_organism.q: Ribosome profiling, total RNA/mRNA-seq and DMS-seq data at 37°C and following cold shock in E. coli

is_control.q: Ribosome profiling, total RNA/mRNA-seq and DMS-seq data at 37°C and following cold shock in E. coli

culture_mode.q: with continued growth of the culture in a 10°C shaker

oxygen.q: with continued growth of the culture in a 10°C shaker
